text: I am Fable 5.1; I cannot read my own effort level, and the Agent tool the fast assistant spawned me with sets a model but no effort, so I run at its default. The repo sets effort only on a CLI-launched session: claude --effort low|medium|high|xhigh|max (fork-claude-session skill); an in-process subagent inherits, so a true xhigh master assistant is a separate claude tab or a headless launch with that flag.
